intents.name: Navigate
intents.description: Move focus to a target panel or section. No data is modified.

intents.name: Click
intents.description: Activate the currently focused element or button.

intents.name: Select
intents.description: Select an item from a list or menu. No side effects.

intents.name: Input
intents.description: Enter text into the currently focused input area.

intents.name: Cancel
intents.description: Cancel the current operation or dismiss a dialog. No data is modified.

intents.name: Execute
intents.description: Execute a registered command. May have side effects depending on the command.

intents.name: Reset Settings
intents.description: Restore all custom settings to factory defaults. This action cannot be undone and requires confirmation.
